tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support the siphon-memory mechanism, but the five pilot rows leave its parameters insufficiently identified. The trajectory batch provides the relevant additional observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify the five coupled parameters; the mechanism note calls for at least eight rows.
Neither accounts for the observed coupled transient lag and memory dependence.
It is irrelevant to resolving the ODE parameters.
